description: Create the satuyangterpenting folder and implement satuyangterpenting-week1.html and satuyangterpenting-week2.html - each containing 21 posts (3 per day for 7 days: pagi/siang/malam) about insurance leads targeting both prospective clients (nasabah) and prospective agents.
steps: Create satuyangterpenting-week1.html following the HTML structure pattern from Petrusjakub-IG-content.html but adapted for the new requirements
Each HTML file must contain: embedded CSS with gradient background, mobile responsive design, card-based post layout, copy-to-clipboard functionality, navigation to jump between posts
Each file has 21 posts organized as Day 1 through Day 7, with 3 posts per day labeled Pagi (morning), Siang (afternoon), Malam (evening)

Content requirements for EVERY post: (1) Written as emotional questions that make readers think and feel urgency, (2) Insurance education content referencing Manulife products from manulife.co.id, (3) Pattern: sell the problem -> ask the right question -> provide Manulife solution -> explain product benefits in simple language, (4) Include a famous person's insurance/financial quote formatted as blockquote, (5) Use text formatting: bold, italic, underline, highlight throughout, (6) Include placeholder image with insurance-related alt text, (7) CTA buttons (not visible links): WhatsApp button linking to WA.me/+6287781896087, Web Nasabah button linking to https://projectcuan.petrusjakub.workers.dev/, Web Rekrut Agen button linking to https://projectcuan.petrusjakub.workers.dev/pages/bisnis, (8) Follow @petrusjakub on Instagram CTA, (9) Use polite Indonesian language - NEVER use gue/gua/elo/elu

Week 1 themes: Hari 1 - Pentingnya asuransi kesehatan (MiUltimate HealthCare), Hari 2 - Proteksi jiwa untuk keluarga (MiWealth Protection), Hari 3 - Dana pendidikan anak (MiEducation), Hari 4 - Pensiun yang tenang (MiRetirement Booster), Hari 5 - Asuransi penyakit kritis (MiEarly Critical Care), Hari 6 - Peluang karir agen asuransi (rekrutmen), Hari 7 - Investasi + proteksi sekaligus (MiWealth Link)

Week 2 themes: Hari 1 - Risiko keuangan tanpa proteksi (MiUltimate HealthCare), Hari 2 - Penghasilan keluarga jika pencari nafkah tiada (MiWealth Protection), Hari 3 - Biaya RS yang terus naik (MiUltimate HealthCare Plus), Hari 4 - Warisan untuk generasi berikutnya (MiWealth Legacy), Hari 5 - Kecelakaan bisa terjadi kapan saja (MiAccident Guard), Hari 6 - Kebebasan finansial sebagai agen (rekrutmen), Hari 7 - Perencanaan keuangan holistik (MiWealth Protection + MiRetirement)
Manulife product mentions must include simplified benefit explanations accessible to laypeople
Style buttons as gradient-colored rounded buttons that don't show the raw URL
acceptance_criteria: satuyangterpenting-week1.html exists with valid HTML structure and exactly 21 posts (7 days x 3 posts)
satuyangterpenting-week2.html exists with valid HTML structure and exactly 21 posts (7 days x 3 posts)
All posts contain emotional questions, Manulife product references, famous quotes, text formatting (bold/italic/underline/highlight), image placeholders, and CTA buttons
All CTA links (WhatsApp, Web Nasabah, Web Rekrut Agen) are present as styled buttons
No instances of gue/gua/elo/elu in the content
HTML files render correctly when opened in a browser
verification: Run: ls /projects/sandbox/M-App/satuyangterpenting/ to confirm files exist
Run: grep -c 'post-card\|post-item' /projects/sandbox/M-App/satuyangterpenting/satuyangterpenting-week1.html to verify 21 post sections
Run: grep -c 'post-card\|post-item' /projects/sandbox/M-App/satuyangterpenting/satuyangterpenting-week2.html to verify 21 post sections
Run: grep -c 'wa.me\|WA.me' /projects/sandbox/M-App/satuyangterpenting/satuyangterpenting-week1.html to confirm WhatsApp CTA presence
Run: grep -c 'projectcuan.petrusjakub.workers.dev' /projects/sandbox/M-App/satuyangterpenting/satuyangterpenting-week1.html to confirm web CTAs
